inspiration: A three-phase skill effect spec per skill id: cast on a hand bone, a trailing shot that can hit several targets, and an explosion list (empty for skill 3). Keep the phase split as data. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/shnok-l2-unity/l2-unity/Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/LineageEffects/3.json

Layered hit sounds keyed on what the monster is made of: a defense list (wet, normal, bone) and a separate damage list, one picked per hit. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/shnok-l2-unity/l2-unity/Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/Meta/Npcgrp_Classic.txt line 1

Monster families share one class name across many spawn ids (zombie, skeleton, virud_lizardman, spider types recur), so a family is one mesh set plus many stat rows. Ref: Npcgrp_Classic.txt lines 1-60
Skill records as flat rows: cast range, cast style, hit time, cool time, reuse delay, mp and hp cost, an animation key and a visual id on one line. Ref: Skillgrp_Classic.txt line 1
Drop data per item: drop animation type, drop radius and a drop texture or mesh key, so each loot drop has its own motion and footprint. Ref: Armorgrp_Classic.txt line 1 (loot drop ceremony topic)

Ambient sound per map region as a JSON list, with music and ambience split into separate banks (Music.bank, AmbSound.bank) and placed by zone. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/shnok-l2-unity/l2-unity/Assets/Resources/Data/Maps/16_24/Meta/16_24_AmbientSounds.json (sound-music topic: ambience beds per biome)

One spell with several named element variants (el_wind_strike with suffixes _ca, _fl, _pr, _ta). Names from folder listing only; look not read. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/shnok-l2-unity/l2-unity/Assets/Resources/Data/Effects/el_wind_strike_fl

briefs.label: Bolt-and-burst spell
briefs.why: cast, flight and blast are three separate data slots, so a spell can be cast only, flight only, or all three
briefs.keep: a cast bound to the hand; a trailing flight that may hit several targets; an optional blast list
briefs.change: attach at the staff tip not the hand; a different trail style; a shockwave ring instead of a blast mesh. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: Gremlin-type skirmisher
briefs.why: the hit sound is chosen from a list keyed on body material, so one monster sounds wet, normal or bony
briefs.keep: small quick monster; material-keyed hit list
briefs.change: key the list on armour type instead of body material; different body proportions; a bright rim tint instead of a plain tone. Recreate as a distinct original

briefs.label: Web-spinner brood
briefs.why: two spider variants share a family name but differ in mesh and stats (giant and poison rows)
briefs.change: different leg and abdomen proportions; a glowing venom sac instead of a palette swap; a web-spit attack instead of the bite. Recreate as a distinct original
briefs.ref: Npcgrp_Classic.txt rows class_name=[LineageMonster.giant_spider] and [LineageMonster.poison_spider]; mesh folder /mnt/frankendom-donors/shnok-l2-unity/l2-unity/Assets/Resources/Data/Animations/LineageMonsters/giant_spider_m00 (look not read)

briefs.label: Watcher orb
briefs.why: a single-eye floater is a readable silhouette at distance
briefs.change: a ring of three smaller eyes; a slow spin telegraph; no beam. Recreate as a distinct original

briefs.label: Plated boulder brute
briefs.why: a slow massive silhouette reads at 375 wide and carries one signature sound
briefs.keep: slow heavy tank; stone-type hit list
briefs.change: moss and crystal inlays instead of plain stone; a different stomp sound; a ground-crack telegraph. Recreate as a distinct original
